description: Verify a webhook delivery locally (no API call). Pass the exact raw request body, the CoinVello-Signature header (t=...,v1=...) and the endpoint secret (whsec_...). Implements the spec: HMAC-SHA256 over "<t>.<raw body>", 300 s tolerance, constant-time compare against any v1. Returns valid=true/false with the reason and the parsed event. Set ignore_timestamp=true when checking an old captured delivery.

ignore_timestamp.description: Skip the replay-window check (only for inspecting historical deliveries).

raw_body.description: Raw body bytes exactly as received (no re-serialisation).

name: verify_webhook_signature
title: Verify a CoinVello-Signature header
